relationships.ikki-kurogane: Tests Ikki's and Stella's strength in a surprise battle at the Bay Dome.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Withstands her Calusaritio Salamander during the test.
relationships.or-gaule: Knows the terror of the Puppet King better than anyone in the League, making him the chosen responder.

periods.summary: Ascaride ambushes Ikki and Stella in black armor at the empty Bay Dome to test their strength, forcing them to cooperate and nearly escalate to their strongest states before Kurono stops the fight. He is identified as the world fourth-ranked Black Knight, a Desperado, and wielder of Orichalcos, armor linked to the concept of indomitability. Later, after the League detects Or-Gaule moving openly in Quedolan, Ascaride is ordered to go to Vermillion because of his personal knowledge of Or-Gaule's danger. He leaves without words, but his clenched fists bleed from anger.

key_events.summary: Tests Ikki and Stella in combat.
Receives the mission to respond to Or-Gaule's Quedolan takeover.

periods.time: Or-Gaule crisis in Quedland and Caldia
periods.label: 畏惧弟弟仍挺身救人的黑骑士

status.current: active at Caldia after driving B.B. away and awaiting League reinforcements
status.condition: psychologically terrified of Or-Gaule but functional

relationships.or-gaule: Younger brother and enemy; she seeks to stop the sacrifices caused by his evil.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Rescues and heals him; asks him to keep her post-confrontation terror private.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Rescues her from Luxel and tells her to act against the war rather than return to certain death.
relationships.norman-creed: Lent her Azure Gate knives for emergency escape.

periods.summary: Alice first appears in Luxel as an unseen silver-haired woman, already investigating Or-Gaule. When Or-Gaule uses Ikki as a shield against Stella, Alice intervenes as the Black Knight, protects Ikki with Unbreakable, cuts off Or-Gaule's arm, and evacuates Stella, Ikki, and Lunaeyes to Freyaveg with Norman Creed's Azure Gate. She explains that Or-Gaule is her brother, a Desperado childlike sadist, and urges Stella to stop the war. After Stella leaves, Alice collapses from terror, revealing how deeply Or-Gaule traumatized her, but she still heals Ikki and later identifies the relay-node principle. At Caldia she shields soldiers from rockets, captures relay nodes, saves Ikki from B.B.'s stomp by enduring crushing damage through endless regeneration, and drives B.B. away by scolding him like a child.

key_events.summary: Intervenes, severs Or-Gaule's arm, and evacuates the heroes.
Explains Or-Gaule's nature and asks Stella to stop the war.
Captures relay nodes and describes the limits of available detectors.
Saves Ikki from B.B. and drives the giant away.

status.current: committed to stopping Or-Gaule in the representative war
status.condition: haunted by the Bloody Cross massacre but steadied by Stella's trust

relationships.or-gaule: Younger brother and mortal target; she blames herself for failing to perceive his evil before Bloody Cross.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Teammate whose growth she observes and supports within Rule of Graces limits.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Protected and healed him with Orichalcos during Caldia; accompanies him to Edelberg.
relationships.edelweiss: Recognized by Edelweiss and familiar with Rule of Graces.

periods.summary: Ascaride heals Ikki and other wounded soldiers after Caldia with Orichalcos and becomes one of Vermillion's strongest available representatives. She drives the group to Edelberg, explains Rule of Graces when Edelweiss asks them to swear, and watches Stella's trial with Tatara. When Tatara's advice and Stella's safety strain the contract, Alice considers knocking Stella out to satisfy Nene's backup plan but generally respects the oath. During the fifth night she tells Stella and Tatara her history with Or-Gaule: as Alice Galle she lived in a loved family until her brother's tenth birthday became the Bloody Cross massacre, after which he used her body against police and fled. Her life since then has been devoted to atonement and ending his violence.

key_events.summary: Included among the League members allowed to join Vermillion's roster.
Explains Rule of Graces and swears not to help Stella.
Tells Stella and Tatara the origin of Or-Gaule and her reason to fight.

periods.time: First phase of the representative war in Luxel city
periods.label: 以复仇执念压倒傀儡王的黑骑士
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League; Vermillion representative team

status.current: has cornered Or-Gaule after crushing his hands and nearly strangling him; at risk from self-strangling thread trap until Stella intervenes
status.condition: physically regenerating but suffocating and emotionally consumed by revenge
status.goal: kill Or-Gaule and end the tragedy that began with the Bloody Cross

personality.summary: Usually composed and protective, but Or-Gaule's presence exposes deep trauma and an uncompromising mission of familial responsibility.
values: accepting responsibility as the surviving sister

relationships.or-gaule: Younger brother, trauma source and target; Alice exists to stop him and cannot be controlled by him again.
relationships.levi-ascaride: Adoptive mentor who gave her the mission and power to pursue Or-Gaule.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Teammate who cuts off Or-Gaule's escape when Alice nearly has him.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Teammate she earlier protected and now fights alongside in the same war.

periods.summary: When the war begins, Alice is thrown into Luxel's residential district and hears puppet reenactments of the villagers from the Bloody Cross massacre begging and mutilating each other. Or-Gaule reveals himself on a church roof, delighting in recreating the trauma. Alice declares that she will kill him and end every tragedy since that day. A flashback shows young Alice after the massacre: League commander Levi Ascaride harshly tells her that, as Or-Gaule's sister and survivor, she must take responsibility and stop him; Alice chooses that mission over forgetting. In battle, Alice's Invincible Armor gives her overwhelming offense, defense and regeneration. Or-Gaule uses his invisible thread nest for midair movement and psychological provocation, gradually luring her into threads. His Marionette fails because Alice's fate-weighted obsession with killing him rejects a repeat of the Bloody Cross. She pushes through Killing Opera and Deus Ex Machina projectiles, forcing Or-Gaule to improvise a strangling trap that uses Alice's own strength to tighten threads around her neck. Even while suffocating, Alice throws her axe, predicts his upward escape with threads, punches him down, crushes both hands, and begins strangling him. Or-Gaule barely escapes by manipulating threads with his toes when Alice's body spasms from oxygen deprivation, but Stella appears above him and blocks the escape with dragon fire.

key_events.summary: Resists Marionette, overwhelms Or-Gaule's threads, and nearly kills him despite suffocation.
Her pursuit corners Or-Gaule until Stella cuts off his final escape route.
